symbols.read: The SELL bias is invalidated: price reclaimed the 722.40 lower pivot and now trades at 718.71, so the prior downside path to 686.36 no longer holds and the combined stance has shifted from SELL to HOLD. The 1H trend remains down and the 4H is still Bearish, but the last 1H candle closed green (715.60→717.72, +0.30%), showing the selling pressure that drove the prior read has stalled. Overhead, the open bear FVG at 726.00–726.48 remains the first cap, with 737.02 as the level that would confirm a full trend reversal against the still-BULLISH regime. Bias is neutral-to-cautious: a clean break and hold above 726.48 reopens upside toward 737.02, while a rejection there and loss of 715.60 would revive the bearish case.

The bias has flipped from bearish to neutral-hold: price rebounded from 81,311.64 to 81,648.01, the 1H trend turned up with a green close (81,509.86→81,600.00, +0.11%), and a bullish FVG (81,383.24–81,470.01) now sits just below price, cushioning dips rather than the prior read's clean overhead path. The short setup stays invalidated — price is above the 81,033.66 entry and below the 82,413.00 stop — but the drift lower that favored the short thesis has reversed, so the combined tag moves from SELL to HOLD. The 4H remains bearish within the BULLISH regime, keeping structure mixed. A clean break below 81,033.66 reopens 77,715.32; acceptance above 84,352.00 flips structure bullish.

Price has bounced off the 2,403.69 lower pivot to 2,420.63, so the decisive break the prior read was waiting for never materialized — instead the level held and the combined signal has shifted from SELL to HOLD, confirming the short remains unactionable. The 2,446–2,455 bear FVG is still unmitigated overhead, but a new bull FVG has opened at 2,411.93–2,413.64 just below price, giving dip-buyers a nearby support shelf and softening the bearish-leaning stance. Bias is now neutral-to-slightly-bullish within a still-bearish 4H: a reclaim of 2,446 neutralizes the overhead FVG and opens the upper pivot at 2,579.88, while a sustained break below 2,403.69 re-arms the downside toward 2,227.50. Invalidation for the bear case is a 2,446 reclaim; invalidation for the bull case is a hold below 2,403.69.

Bias stays bearish but the short remains invalidated: price at 104.16 is still below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the 107.16 entry with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 cannot be armed. What changed from the prior read is a modest bounce — price recovered from 103.44 to 104.16, the last 1H print flipped positive to 103.88→104.11 (+0.22%) after the prior -0.69%, and a bull FVG has opened at 103.54–103.78, giving the first structural support beneath price that the prior read noted was absent. The combined read has shifted from SELL to HOLD even as the 4H stays bearish and the 1H trend stays down, so the downside path toward 100.92 is now cushioned rather than open. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a reclaim of 107.16; until that prints, nothing is live.

Price remains pinned at 56.97, so nothing has changed: the 4H bearish structure and combined SELL signal hold with no level breaks, trend flips, or gap fills. The 58.41 short entry stays expired and untriggered, stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, and the bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 still caps as nearest supply while the 1H trend grinds down. Bias stays bearish toward 55.37, with a sustained reclaim of 58.41 the invalidation that would flip the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price is unchanged at 4,165.42, so the read confirms the prior HOLD with the same neutral-to-long bias from the still-bullish 4H and up 1H trend. Nothing has broken: the 1H stall at 4,168.84 and the invalidated SELL at 4,141.44 remain intact, and with no open FVGs price is still trading on structure alone between 4,217.40 and 4,141.44. The trigger set is unchanged — a sustained break below 4,141.44 flips the bias bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target, while a push through 4,217.40 confirms the long side. Conviction stays weak until one of those levels gives, so this is a confirmation of the prior read, not a revision.

The SELL signal is now invalidated and the combined bias has shifted from SELL to HOLD, so the prior neutral-to-short stance no longer holds as an active trade. Price stalled at 1.30 rather than extending toward 1.20, and a new bull FVG at 1.2948–1.2972 has opened beneath price, giving the first downside support cushion that wasn't there before. The bear FVGs at 1.3154–1.328 and 1.3283–1.3297 remain the operative resistance capping any bounce, and the 1.31 lower pivot now sits just overhead as the level to reclaim. Bias is neutral: 4H still bearish and 1H still down, but the invalidated sell plus the fresh bull FVG and BULLISH regime flag argue against pressing shorts. Invalidation: a decisive hold above 1.3283–1.3297 flips structure bullish and reopens 1.43, while losing 1.2948 breaks the new bull FVG and revives the 1.20 path.
